name: The million lives particle field
description: About 1,000 particles on a canvas, each standing for 1,000 lives. As the cohort ages, particles fade out so that the visible count always equals the engine's number. The field draws a picture of the engine's output and never calculates mortality. File: src/particles.mjs plus a <canvas id=field> in index.html.

userStories.title: src/particles.mjs with a pure visibleCount helper
userStories.description: Create src/particles.mjs exporting: visibleCount(lx, l0, total=1000) which returns Math.round(total * lx / l0) (pure, no DOM); createField(canvas, total=1000) which makes an array of particles { x, y, r, phase, alive:true, fade:1 } with positions from Math.random spread across the canvas and r between 1.5 and 3; and update(field, aliveCount, dtMs) which marks particles dead in a FIXED order (index ascending from the end of the array) so that exactly aliveCount remain alive, reduces fade towards 0 over 400 ms for dead ones, drifts every particle by a tiny sine-based offset using phase and dt, and draws them (alpha = fade, with a soft glow using shadowBlur 8). Add <canvas id=field> to index.html and call createField once and update every frame from app.mjs with aliveCount = visibleCount(baseline[currentAge - startAge], 1000000).
acceptanceCriteria: tests/particles.test.mjs asserts visibleCount(1000000,1000000) === 1000, visibleCount(0,1000000) === 0, visibleCount(500500,1000000) === 501, and passes under node --test
In the browser at age 0 all particles are visible; at 121 none
Math.random appears only in createField; update and visibleCount use none
One canvas, no DOM element per particle; drawing 1,000 particles per frame without dropping below 50 fps in Chrome devtools

userStories.title: Deaths fade, survivors drift, reset restores
userStories.description: Dead particles shrink to 60% of their radius while fading over the same 400 ms. Living particles keep drifting while paused. Reset sets every particle alive with fade=1 immediately. Pause stops the age advancing but update keeps running for drift.
acceptanceCriteria: Playing from age 60 shows the field visibly thinning between ages 75 and 100
Reset shows all 1,000 particles within one frame
Pause: the age stops changing and the particles keep drifting

technicalNotes.rationale: One pure helper with tests and a specified canvas routine.
